title: SatDL: Jointly Optimizing Data Redistribution and Training for Satellite-Based Distributed Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.24516v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Satellite-based distributed learning promises to train machine-learning models directly in orbit using massive, globally dispersed sensor data, thereby avoiding large-scale data downloads to ground servers. However, training convergence is significantly slowed by severe non-IID data, specifically label imbalance, as each satellite observes different geographic regions with distinct labels. This imbalance extends training duration and increases energy consumption for solar-powered satellites. Existing approaches either fully redistribute data to enforce IID conditions - accelerating convergence but incurring substantial communication delays - or avoid redistribution entirely by modifying local learning algorithms to mitigate the impact of label imbalance, which, however, still prolong training and increase energy use. translated_title: SatDL：联合优化卫星分布式学习中的数据重分配与训练
translated_abstract: 基于卫星的分布式学习有望直接利用全球分散的传感器数据在轨道上训练机器学习模型，从而避免将大规模数据下载到地面服务器。然而，由于每颗卫星观测到具有不同标签的不同地理区域，训练收敛受到严重非独立同分布（non-IID）数据（特别是标签不平衡）的显著拖慢。这种不平衡延长了训练时长，并增加了太阳能供电卫星的能耗。现有方法要么完全重新分配数据以强制执行IID条件——加速收敛但产生大量通信延迟，要么完全避免重新分配，通过修改本地学习算法来减轻标签不平衡的影响，但这仍会延长训练并增加能耗。这两种极端情况都会导致过长的端到端总学习时间（数据传输延迟加训练时间），从而增加资源消耗。
tldr: 该论文提出SatDL方法，通过联合优化数据重分配和训练策略，在卫星分布式学习中平衡通信延迟和训练时间，以最小化端到端学习总时长并降低能耗。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SatDL, which jointly optimizes data redistribution and training to balance communication delay and training time in satellite-based distributed learning, minimizing total end-to-end learning time and energy consumption.
